_note: Slide 18 verbatim (target index renamed so it cannot collide with the Transform output the demo actually uses). Apply with: python3 bin/bootstrap.py --with-rollup. Read docs/SLIDE-VS-REALITY.md item 4 before you demo this: the target index stores internal field names ('@timestamp.date_histogram', 'gen_ai.agent.id.terms', 'http.request.body.size.sum'), avg is decomposed into sum + value_count, and the plugin installs a search interceptor so you query it with the ORIGINAL field names. Hand-written queries against the internal names bypass the rewriter and return wrong or empty results.
